brief:
British singer Ed Sheeran faces mounting boycott calls and artist desertions over his stance on Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. The controversy has created what observers describe as a career crisis for one of the world's biggest musical stars, reflecting broader divisions over the conflict.

The situation illustrates how even globally prominent figures are being drawn into political divisions surrounding Gaza, with consequences for their professional standing and public support.
